J x G — THE VOLUME SIGNAL CROSSED WITH THE ZONE (ECONOMICS_SIM_PRODUCTION_REBASE.md §5.33).
Measures only. Signals: SMA (production's window sum), median (the window's lower-middle
per-block count), median+floor (the median, the stuffer paying the relay floor on its own
bodies), decoupled (release rails at 1.0; the burn and C still read the sum). Zone: N
2-in/2-out spends of 19939 B (genesis depth and Standard fee) plus the coinbase reserve
(1386 B), beside the inherited and re-derived zones; w_ref at 3000 and 12595 B, each fixed across
N. Not re-derived: TX_WEIGHT_LIMIT (the sim does not read it; it caps one transaction, not a
count) and COINBASE_RESERVE (it does not depend on the zone).

THE HONEST CHAIN. Per signal, zone and w_ref: the year-1 Standard fee (SKL, and over the
ceiling), a day's blocks filled to the zone at the year-1 relay floor (SKL), the first year
blocks carry the design load (30 spends, 48 ordinary transactions a block), and the
declared step's up-edge: M_r before and after, and the blocks to 95 % of the move.

THE STUFFER. Per signal, zone, w_ref and start: a stuffer holding its share (100 = every miner)
for the whole measured span (2160 blocks from the start of the year); the bodies listed, M_r
at the span's end and its mean over it, the longest run of M_r > 1.0, the stuffer's payout
less its fees against no stuffing (SKL), and the burn and C at rest. A share is an even
proportion of the blocks; the bodies are the ordinary 1-in/2-out, the lightest valid shape
(CEN-I1).
